description: Republish via pnpm so the packed CLI rewrites workspace:* to a real @decade666/trellis-core version.
changelog:
**Release packaging:**
- chore(cli): bump to 0.6.13 and publish via pnpm. 0.6.12 was published with `npm publish`, which left `@decade666/trellis-core: workspace:*` unresolved in the tarball and caused `npm i -g` to fail with `EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL`.

**Continuity note:** the published tarball did not bundle a migration manifest. No filesystem migration was shipped in this package.
